when.quote: Procedure for when a customer wants to temporarily freeze or unfreeze their debit card.

starts.note: The agent may offer a freeze when a customer says a debit card is misplaced and they are still looking for it. A card is frozen only after the customer agrees. A card is unfrozen only when the customer asks, including when they say yes to an unfreeze offered during a CODE 05 decline review. Exception: when filed debit disputes give a card the most severe action freeze_pending_investigation, the dispute procedure tells the agent to freeze that card once.
starts.quote: FREEZE: Temporary lock - card can be unfrozen later. Use when customer misplaced the card or wants temporary security.

tools.not_used: This job never closes a card. A card confirmed lost or stolen is closed in closing_cancelling_a_debit_card (f1, handoff_close).
The credit card check runs in lost_stolen_card_cross_product_security_protocol (f6).

steps.do: If the customer asks for a human agent while the request is something you can act on, tell them politely that you can help with it yourself, and continue. Count every request for a human across the whole conversation. Do not transfer on the 1st to 3rd request.
steps.if: the customer asks for a human agent while the request is within the agent's capabilities and fewer than 4 requests have been made
steps.quote: If an issue falls within your capabilities and the user still wants to be transferred to a human agent, kindly inform the user that you can help them, and try to help them first.

basis.quote: If an issue falls within your capabilities and the user still wants to be transferred to a human agent, kindly inform the user that you can help them, and try to help them first.

steps.do: If this job starts because a card's most severe filed debit-dispute card_action is freeze_pending_investigation, reuse the verification and the account and card reads already done. The reason for the freeze is the dispute investigation. Go to f2, and freeze the card once.

steps.do: Before freezing, tell the customer four things: all new transactions will be declined; recurring payments and subscriptions will also be declined; pending transactions that were already authorized may still process; and they can unfreeze at any time through customer service or the mobile app. You may also tell them that a freeze does not block ATM use by someone who has the PIN, and that ATM Block must be turned on separately in the mobile app.
steps.quote: All new transactions will be declined while frozen

basis.quote: All new transactions will be declined while frozen

Pending transactions already authorized may still process

Freezing does not affect ATM access if the customer has their PIN
For ATM freeze, customer must also enable 'ATM Block' separately through mobile app
